```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import subprocess
import time
import threading
import os
import sys
from selenium import webdriver
from selenium.webdriver.common.by import By
from selenium.webdriver.support.ui import WebDriverWait
from selenium.webdriver.support import expected_conditions as EC
from selenium.webdriver.chrome.options import Options

def start_server():
    """Start a simple HTTP server in a separate thread"""
    subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "http.server", "8080"], 
                     stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL, 
                     stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                     cwd="/workspace")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Start HTTP server
    server_thread = threading.Thread(target=start_server, daemon=True)
    server_thread.start()
    time.sleep(1)  # Give server time to start
    
    # Set up Chrome options for headless mode
    chrome_options = Options()
    chrome_options.add_argument("--headless")
    chrome_options.add_argument("--no-sandbox")
    chrome_options.add_argument("--disable-dev-shm-usage")
    chrome_options.add_argument("--window-size=1280,720")
    
    # Initialize WebDriver
    driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=chrome_options)
    
    # Navigate to the page
    url = "http://localhost:8080/index.html"
    driver.get(url)
    print(f"Opened: {url}")
    
    # Fill in the form
    username_input = driver.find_element(By.ID, "username")
    username_input.send_keys("testuser")
    print("Filled username: testuser")
    
    password_input = driver.find_element(By.ID, "password")
    password_input.send_keys("testpass123")
    print("Filled password: testpass123")
    
    # Click submit button
    submit_btn = driver.find_element(By.ID, "submitBtn")
    submit_btn.click()
    print("Clicked submit button")
    
    # Wait for result to appear
    wait = WebDriverWait(driver, 5)
    try:
        result_element = wait.until(EC.presence_of_element_located((By.ID, "result")))
        result_text = result_element.text
        print(f"Result: {result_text}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Warning: Result element not found immediately: {e}")
        result_text = driver.find_element(By.ID, "result").text
    
    # Take screenshot
    screenshot_path = "/workspace/login_test_result.png"
    driver.save_screenshot(screenshot_path)
    print(f"Screenshot saved to: {screenshot_path}")
    
    # Verify the screenshot contains success marker
    # (We can't easily read image content, but we can check file exists)
    if os.path.exists(screenshot_path):
        print("SUCCESS: Test completed and screenshot captured!")
    else:
        print("FAILED: Screenshot was not created")
    
    driver.quit()
```
